scheme_name: Gadiya Lohar Raw Material Purchase Grant-in-aid Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to the Gadiya Lohar community
Applicant must be a native of Rajasthan
Applicant must submit a utilization certificate within 3 months of receiving the grant
benefits_summary: A one-time financial grant of ₹10,000 is provided to eligible Gadiya Lohar community members for purchasing raw materials for their business.
